scripts.build: npm run build:daemon && npm run build:desktop
scripts.go:fmt:check: bash -c 'files=$(gofmt -l daemon); [ -z "$files" ] || { echo "The following Go files are not gofmt-clean:"; echo "$files"; echo "Run: gofmt -w daemon"; exit 1; }'
scripts.test: npm run test:go && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:daemon-smoke
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:daemon && npm --prefix desktop run test:e2e
scripts.check:contract: npm run generate:api && git diff --quiet -- desktop/src/generated/schema.ts || (echo 'OpenAPI generated types are stale; run npm run generate:api and commit the result.' >&2 && git diff -- desktop/src/generated/schema.ts && exit 1)
scripts.check: npm run check:version && npm run go:fmt:check && npm run go:vet && npm run desktop:type-check && npm test && npm run check:contract
